Possibly the best pizza we've ever had
Apr 2026 • Couples
We came here based on Tripadvisor recommendations and were not disappointed. In fact, it may have been the best pizza we’ve ever had—and we found it in Vung Tau.

From the moment we sat down, the service was fantastic. We ordered two pizzas and a salad. I chose the Speck and Gorgonzola pizza and added olives, while my partner ordered the same without olives.

The pizzas were exceptional. It’s hard to say whether it was the base, the cheese, the speck, or just the perfect combination of everything, but they were truly outstanding—well beyond our expectations.

It really felt like enjoying a traditional Italian restaurant meal right in Vung Tau. Even though the place was busy, our salad and pizzas were prepared and served without a long wait.

Highly recommend giving this restaurant a try if you’re in Vung Tau.

Fabulous Pizza for a reasonable price.
Oct 2025 • Couples
We enjoyed a large Pazza pizza (half with & half without olives) between 2 adults for lunch. The crust was great; the tomato sauce base was just right. You could taste the slight acidity of the tomatoes, and it wasn’t watered down like some pizzerias. The cheese and Parma ham were good quality. The price of 180,000 VND is extremely good compared to some of the overpriced pizzas we have encountered around Vietnam. We highly recommend this restaurant for the pizza and the excellent service by staff with good English.

Authentic Napoletana Pizza in Vietnam
Dec 2024 • Couples
What a beautiful rainy romantic night dining on the second floor of Luca Ristorante. 
It was pretty full with diners mostly foreigners. I have to say, I'm Italian, born in Italy and I felt right at home. I've been in the restaurant business all my life and now I'm a restaurant consult in California. I've been to Vietnam several times and I'm a big fan of Pizza 4P, so the bar for Luca was set really high! My first impressions were that the staff is well trained, observant, hard working and caring of the customer experience. We started our 4 course meal with the Caesar salad and some focaccia bread. Bread was nice, soft, and good on salt. Bread sticks had an odd taste. Greens were crisp, bacon tasty but a little light on the dressing. 2nd we had the Gnocchi alla Crema di parmigiana e prosciutto. This dish was a big let down. Arrived nuke war, dry, lacking any salt or cream, more of a butter sauce and the supposed "prosciutto" was some kind of asian chopped sausage that was burnt. 3rd, Pizza with ham and mushrooms, I have to say this pizza was fantastic. Arrived hot, cooked to perfection. It edged out Pizza 4P. The pizza dough was most definetly imported from Italy.
And finally the Tiramisu was tasty. Light, not too rich but a little heavy on the powered chocolate. I informed the manager that night of my experience, he seemed appreciative. Would have loved to meet a fellow Italian Giovanni but was told he was back in Italy. 
Analysis on a scale of 1 to 5:
Service and overall staff (5) excellent, Bread (4) Good, Salad (4) Good, 
Gnocchi (1) poor, Pizza (5) fanatastic, Tiramisu (5) tasty. 
In closing, I highly recommend this fantastic Restaurant. I will definitely be back!
Sono Massimo. Ci vediamo la prossima volta, grazie Giovanni.
